claims.text: Many reviewers report the device stops working or breaks after only a short time, often within one to five uses or about a month.
Several reviewers report charging problems, including units that will not hold a charge, will not recharge, or have broken charging ports.
Some reviewers say the device lacks power and stalls or stops spinning under slight pressure.
Some reviewers praise the product for effectively removing calluses and softening feet, even after one use.
A few reviewers describe the product as cheaply made or defective.
